readiness_decision: Strong usable stage recreation. V5 concrete shadow and sprite-base defects are resolved or reduced to minor finish issues. It remains just below 9/10 on the same source-fidelity bar because apron material/lighting is still visibly simplified and repeated atlas detail is discernible in the cloud.

included: Floor continuity, stage lighting and shadows
Pressure jets and vapor, including landing and 13-second clearance
excluded: Car model geometry, materials and pending hero-form repairs
Reliability of metric reconstruction or measured 6DoF
Temporal effects coherence not established by still captures
scope.method: Fresh view_image reads of all 17 frozen V6 screenshots and five actual source frames, plus read-only manifest/hash verification. No IWSDK App CLI or browser automation, no live camera/input changes, no source/app edits, and no consultation of other judge reports.

mismatches.disposition: Expected independent live model repair; model quality is outside this review, and all frozen screenshot hashes match.

hash_evidence.note: All stage/effects/code/texture entries matched the manifest at initial check. Judgment applies to the immutable screenshots, not subsequent live model bytes.

v5_findings_retested.evidence: The isolated black car silhouette is gone from release, wide and overhead. Ready/car/landing still have sufficient short grounding/contact darkness. The large ramp/truss shadow also remains absent.

The bottom of the descent clusters is softer and less shelf-like. Landing still hides most of the car and retains a substantial irregular vapor mass. At 13 seconds the car is clear while the trailing cloud has a translucent/darkened edge. The stronger blue-gray atlas lobes and opacity aging remain visible.
The floor is still mainly identical smooth cool pools over near-black diffuse material with no dim white apron/track markings or strong rough grazing reflection seen in wide_17 and overhead-37.

remaining_material_gap.evidence: Actual source overhead-37 and wide_17 have rough grazing/reflected illumination across a visibly textured apron, thin white floor/track markings, uneven light footprints and red spill. Current ready/overhead show much more uniform oval pools and an almost featureless dark surface. This is a simplified stage finish, even though the important dark background, red boundaries, low banks and ramp silhouette are present.
remaining_material_gap.actionable_fix: Use source-supported thin dim white apron/track markings, subtle broad rough/specular grazing response and small variation in bank intensity/aim. Keep the floor dark and preserve the fade. Avoid raising global ambient light or adding unrelated props.
remaining_material_gap.caveat: Source camera and light placement differ from the app, so exact pixel matching is not required. Peripheral vehicles, equipment and audience are outside this stage review.

minor_finish.evidence: The cloud now has convincing texture and irregular silhouette, but similarly sized small cauliflower lobes repeat throughout its interior. The source has stronger coarse variation and larger smooth/dark interior masses. This is now minor compared with V3/V5 defects, not a request to remove supported cloud volume.
minor_finish.possible_polish: If another effects pass is justified, mix fewer/larger puffs with differently stretched wisps and preserve broad dark interior areas. Do not reduce the whole cloud uniformly.

minor_finish.evidence: Full-path wide-end retains a faint black rectangle/background tone transition near the distant floor extent. It is subtle and no longer resembles the bright V2 island.
minor_finish.possible_polish: Make the last floor fade converge to the exact scene background color.

minor_finish.evidence: Controls remain usable and do not cover the active car/ramp region in the supplied views. The persistent panel and tiny supporting text are visually heavy for a presentation, but are not a stage blocker.

preserve: No high ramp or airborne-car hard black shadow; maintain grounded contact.
Thin noisy jets rather than opaque cyan cones.
Substantial local touchdown occlusion, visible 13s car clearance and lingering aged cloud.
Continuous center paint and consistent brace cadence.
Landscape and portrait action framing; full-path wide option despite its naturally small far-end actor.
limitations: Still images cannot verify billboard sorting/popping, motion coherence or shadow transition behavior around the height threshold.
No dedicated 10.0s capture isolates the stronger pressure-column phase visible in source; the 9.5s jets remain plausible.
The overhead view shows the upper ramp outer/back face. Absence of center paint on that face is not treated as a new defect.
Clean runtime logs were reported by the author; this review did not independently operate the app or inspect live logs.
No stage score is a claim of uniquely recovered measured 6DoF or physical plume accuracy.
conclusion: 8.8/10, not yet a 9/10 source-grounded finish. V6 confirms the requested shadow and vapor-base corrections without erasing the cloud. The remaining significant gap is the already identified apron rendering fidelity; no critical functional stage issue was found in the supplied evidence.
